notes: The baseline. No joins, no expressions -- every answer comes straight from pg_attribute.attnotnull. If this case ever regresses, pass 1 is broken. The WHERE clause is the common optional-filter idiom, which also exercises a parameter used twice: both occurrences must collapse to one $1 for DESCRIBE and one %(min_id)s for psycopg. The oracle binds it to NULL, so the filter is a no-op and every seeded row is returned as evidence.
